record_audits.database_subject: Discovery and analysis of a novel antimicrobial peptide B1AW from the skin secretion of Amolops wuyiensis and improving the membrane-binding affinity through the construction of the lysine-introduced analogue.
record_audits.review_notes: Primary XML supports the peptide sequence and many activity values, but the APD6 free-text entry also contains database-derived similarity/molecular-property statements not independently located in the primary source; retained as source_conflict rather than source_verified.
record_audits.conflict_context: APD6 broad free-text row mixes source-supported activity/toxicity values with database-only APD analysis text; use row-level source activity records for publishable values.
